control.endTooltip: Warning: the session will be destroyed (PIN invalidated, players disconnected). This cannot be undone.

control.archiveHint: Leaderboard and statistics will remain available after the session.

joinAddressHelp.why: Participants’ phones open this address to join. “localhost” or “127.0.0.1” only work on this computer: a phone cannot reach them, so the QR code and the link would lead nowhere.
joinAddressHelp.whereTitle: On a local instance, use this computer’s network address
joinAddressHelp.where: (an IP like 192.168.x.x), keeping the port of this page{{port}}:
joinAddressHelp.mac: Mac: System Settings › Wi‑Fi › Details… next to your network › IP address (or Network › your connection).
joinAddressHelp.windows: Windows: Settings › Network & internet › Wi‑Fi (or Ethernet) › your network › IPv4 address.
joinAddressHelp.linux: Linux: the network indicator › connection details, or “ip a” in a terminal.
joinAddressHelp.sameNetwork: Phones must be on the same Wi‑Fi / network as this computer, and its firewall must let the port through.
joinAddressHelp.deployed: On a server with a domain name, set APP_PUBLIC_URL in the configuration: it is then offered first.
joinAddressHelp.publicConfigured: This instance is configured with a public address ({{url}}): use it, it is the one participants can reach from anywhere.
joinAddressHelp.lanKnown: The addresses listed are this machine’s on the local network: pick the one of the network the participants are on (Wi‑Fi, wired).
joinAddressHelp.lanHidden: This instance runs in Docker Desktop (or a container on a bridge network), which hides the computer’s network: no local address could be detected. Type it below — or add HOST_LAN_IPS=<your IP> to the .env file (or “-e HOST_LAN_IPS=…” on docker run) so it is listed here next time.
joinAddressHelp.https: This page is served over HTTPS: an http:// local address will show a warning on phones — a public address with a certificate is the clean way.

rules.multiple_choice: Several correct answers — tick them all, then submit. All or nothing.
rules.text_input: Type your answer — case, accents and extra spaces are ignored.
rules.numeric: Enter a number — close enough counts.
